datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Guatemala on a monthly basis throughout 2013 (January, April, July, October). The classifications were spatially referenced to administrative or livelihood zones and encoded in GeoJSON and KML formats to represent the geographic distribution of food insecurity phases.
